text_block_list.text:
A pep rally organized by volunteers within 
Tracen Academy for the Prix de l'Arc de 
Triomphe.

"Thinking we might find some useful 
information, I joined alongside Nakayama 
Festa, but—"

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
Now then, everyone please raise your 
glasses— Merry Christmas!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Ha, what kind of pep rally is this? It's 
practically a Christmas party.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Lavish food, gorgeous decorations... Quite 
the magnificent setup.
choice_data_list:
Are you thinking of leaving early, by any 
chance?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"I'd love nothing more, but... we might 
hear something about the Prix de l'Arc de 
Triomphe, so I can't miss it."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"Don't get your hopes up too high, but 
I'll stay until we reach a good stopping 
point."

text_block_list.name: Man A
text_block_list.text:
"Hey there, Merry Christmas! That's a 
lovely outfit. It's absolutely perfect for 
today's party."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Much obliged.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
choice_data_list: Excuse me, she seems a little nervous...!

text_block_list.text:
"As I thought, they don't seem to be 
enjoying the party. ...A feeling of regret 
wells up at that fact."

She's been spending grueling days 
preparing for the Prix de l'Arc de 
Triomphe. I'd like to let her catch her 
breath for today, at least, but—
choice_data_list:
(...I wonder if I can help her have some 
fun.)

(...I wonder if there's something I can do 
to entertain her.)

text_block_list.name: Organizer
text_block_list.text:
Thank you all for gathering today. We will 
also be holding a social gathering 
afterward, so please continue to enjoy—

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: See ya. I'm heading out first.
choice_data_list:
Wait. Do you have some free time after 
this?
Wait. Are you free after this?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: What's up?
choice_data_list: There's a place I want to go with you.
There's a place I want to go with you.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
With me...? Well, I don't really mind, I 
guess.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Hey, how far are we gonna walk? ...Oh—

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Is this... an oden cart?
choice_data_list:
Yeah. If you don't mind, would you come 
with me?

text_block_list.name: Oden Stall Landlady
text_block_list.text:
Here you go, order up. Chikuwabu and 
hanpen, right?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Thanks. ...The broth really soaked into 
this daikon. You can't get this kind of 
flavor without proper prep work.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: You really know some great spots, huh.
choice_data_list:
The amazake at this stall is exceptional, 
too.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
! Heh, not bad. ...Landlady, I'll take 
one.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Whew... That hits the spot.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Hot oden and amazake under the chilly sky, 
at a quiet food stall... Not bad.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Good grief, you're quite an eccentric one.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Even though it's Christmas, you're eating 
oden in a quiet place like this with me, 
of all people.
choice_data_list: Because I wanted you to enjoy Christmas.
Because I wanted you to enjoy Christmas.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Hah, is that so? ...In that case—

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"Come with me to one more place. ...Don't 
tell me you're done already?"

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
If it's food stalls, there should be some 
around here—oh...

Looking over, there was a food stall 
standing in the shadows. With no other 
customers, it had a somewhat suspicious 
vibe...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Heh, interesting. Once you step past that 
shop curtain, is it paradise, or is it 
hell...?
choice_data_list: ...I-If you want to go, I'll go too!
...Ah, if you want to go, I'll go too!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Heh heh, that's the spirit. ...In that 
case, how about we settle this between the 
two of us—

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Let's feel that blood-pumping heat.

In the dim shadows of the back alley, time 
with her slipped away. And then—

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"Haha! That was one thrilling gamble. And 
we got to eat such delicious offal stew 
out of it, too."
choice_data_list: I want to go out to eat together again.
I'd love to go out to eat together again.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Ah, that sounds good. ...Oh—

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Look, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that's right. It is Christmas, after 
all. ...Hey, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Merry Christmas. ...I think I'll be able 
to sleep well tonight.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Heh, why not just keep wandering like 
this? Spending the whole night with you 
sounds nice too.
choice_data_list: As a Trainer, I can't just overlook that

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: "Haha! Thought as much. ...In that case—"

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
The least we can do is walk back to the 
dorms chatting. ...You can spare that much 
time, can't you?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...Oh, what's over there... That's just 
perfect.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Join me for a can of coffee. ...On a 
freezing night like this, nothing hits the 
spot quite like it, y'know?
